_comment: Authoritative spoken script. Timing anchors are relative to shot IDs in shots.json. Record one continuous scratch narration before changing durations.

voice.narrator: Mature American civil-service trainer, dry, precise, medium-low register. No menace, irony or wonder.
voice.peter: Genuinely asking for procedural help, not frightened.
voice.witness: Casual certainty produced by the corrected record.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Welcome to the Continuity Adjustment Unit.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A contradiction is not two events. It is two records competing for one event. Determine which account can be maintained.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: At eight forty-three Monday, June Havel reported a mug three days before purchase.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: It's warm.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Temperature is not proof. Premature property should not be used. Use creates history.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The future receipt was designated authoritative. The purchase moved to Friday.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: June's cafeteria purchase conflicted with her hospital admission. The admission was retained by assigning it to Peter Gray.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: To whom?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Secondary displacement is normal.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Peter's Friday location was now St. Orison. His street record became an unassigned event.

lines.speaker: PETER
lines.text: Where should I have been?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Do not answer. An answer is a location.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Mara documented Peter as recurring. Witness recollection reconciled immediately.

lines.speaker: WITNESS
lines.text: He walks here every day.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Linked cases do not imply causation. Released histories go to the first compatible employee file.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Lina Ortiz returned from lunch carrying Peter's documented childhood.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Lina retained photographed birthdays. Peter retained nightmares and undocumented affection.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: They remember the same mother.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Recognition follows the approved record.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: They cannot both be true.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Truth is not a continuity requirement.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Approved instruction supersedes lived experience.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Mara's objection created a personnel discrepancy. Reassignment was economical.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: If discrepancies remain, update the employee.
